Database.Password: <set with: dotnet user-secrets set Database:Password ...  or env var WCS_DB_PASSWORD - never commit>

DataProtection.KeysPath: <optional folder that stores the key ring used to encrypt PLC/RCS passwords and tokens; back it up, keep it outside the repository>

Admin.Password: <optional. If set: used as the first administrator's password (user secrets / env Bootstrap__Admin__Password, never commit). If NOT set: the default account admin/admin is created outside Production only>
Admin.AllowDefaultCredentials: <optional true/false. Default: true outside Production, false in Production>
